title: RACO: Reliability-Aware Coarse-Goal Optimization for Inspection-Oriented UAV Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) is commonly evaluated as goal reaching, but inspection-oriented deployment requires the agent to stop within a valid inspection region and avoid falsely confirming visually or semantically similar distractors. This requirement exposes a key weakness in existing coarse-to-fine UAV-VLN policies: the coarse goal predicted before local refinement is often treated as reliable, although it may drift toward plausible but incorrect object regions and limit the ability of the local stage to recover. To systematically evaluate this problem, we introduce LG-UVI, an object-centric inspection evaluation setting derived from CityNav/CityRefer. LG-UVI extends standard UAV-VLN episodes with target objects, hard distractors, type-aware inspection regions, and diagnostics for inspection-region arrival and object-level confirmation. translated_title: 面向巡检的无人机视觉语言导航中可靠性感知的粗略目标优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22678v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）通常以目标到达作为评估标准，但面向巡检的部署要求智能体在有效巡检区域内停止，并避免错误确认视觉或语义上相似的干扰物。这一要求暴露了现有从粗到细UAV-VLN策略的关键弱点：在局部细化之前预测的粗略目标常被视为可靠，尽管它可能漂移到看似合理但错误的对象区域，并限制局部阶段恢复的能力。为系统评估此问题，我们引入了LG-UVI，一种从CityNav/CityRefer派生的面向对象的巡检评估设置。LG-UVI扩展了标准UAV-VLN任务，包含目标对象、硬干扰物、类型感知巡检区域，以及用于巡检区域到达和对象级确认的诊断。为解决这一面向巡检的设置，我们进一步提出了RACO，一种可靠性感知的粗略目标优化方法。
tldr: 本文提出RACO方法，通过可靠性感知的粗略目标优化，解决巡检场景下无人机视觉语言导航中粗略目标不可靠导致误检干扰物的问题，并引入LG-UVI评估设置。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RACO, a reliability-aware coarse-goal optimization method to address unreliable coarse goals in inspection-oriented UAV visual-language navigation, and introduces the LG-UVI evaluation setting.
